subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw core own the proposed experimental Claw package-to-agent lifecycle and its durable provenance/recovery state, or should this work remain outside core until a narrower missing extension API is identified?
rationale: The branch is technically bounded and proof-backed, but it introduces a new persistent orchestration product surface that VISION.md treats as a maintainer choice rather than an ordinary bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental core lifecycle
options.body: Accept the one-agent/one-workspace scope, durable recovery contract, and staged follow-on work as a maintained core feature.

options.title: Keep planning read-only for now
options.body: Retain or land only non-mutating inspection/planning work while deferring agent creation and provenance persistence pending a core ownership design.

options.title: Route orchestration outside core
options.body: Ask for a plugin or ClawHub-oriented implementation unless a concrete missing SDK or lifecycle API gap is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental core lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the one-agent/one-workspace scope, durable recovery contract, and staged follow-on work as a maintained core feature.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level core-scope and roadmap decision, and the repository contribution guide identifies this account as the project decision owner.
